name: worlds-of-book
description: Local multi-platform posting pathway verification tool

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @wob/server" "npm run dev -w @wob/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @wob/publish-core && npm run build -w @wob/server && npm run build -w @wob/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @wob/publish-core && npm run typecheck -w @wob/server && npm run typecheck -w @wob/web
